world.reaching_variant_rule: for all three goal objects, add (goal_dx,goal_dy,0) to defaults
world.pushing_variant_rule: tool block initial x subtract goal_dx, goal block x add goal_dx and y add goal_dy, all z unchanged
world.evidence: real reset PUBLIC observation vector and real env.step rewards, every variant×action reset independently; verify paired exact starting observation and distinct action bytes

study.candidate_features: public env.reset observation (whole flattened vector, deterministic fixed 128 dimensions with tanh(value/0.5), zero padded); no task variant id, hidden geometry, future outcome or task label supplied to learner
study.model_family_split: separate FIT per family and identical 16 action/reward examples to all family models; fitted policy gets known family only, never variant IDs
study.tie_rule: first lower action id, then lower FIT variant id
study.retention: serialize all learned model arrays/rows to canonical JSON, reload, verify every fitted method prediction bitwise identical on all FIT reset observations before CHECK/DEV

decision_predeclared.source_variation: for each family at least 4 unique FIT initial observations and 2 unique DEV initial observations, DEV observation hashes not in FIT, plus >=1 distinct reward vector between DEV contexts and action reward span>0.05 for each of two DEV variants; otherwise SOURCE_CONTEXT_NOT_QUALIFIED
decision_predeclared.comparator_calibration: in each family at least one fitted conventional method gives higher average real DEV reward than untrained fixed-low by >=0.01; otherwise CONVENTIONAL_IMPROVEMENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED
decision_predeclared.context_generalization: fitted nearest-neighbor or ridge method must beat FIT-trained family mean action on mean DEV reward by at least +0.01 in BOTH families, and must choose DIFFERENT actions across two DEV contexts in at least one family; otherwise CONTEXTUAL_GENERALIZATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED
decision_predeclared.explicit_nonclaims: even if all tests pass, this is a tiny public development source-conditioned transfer screen; not native Wingless/Yggdrasil learning, not FSA admission, not real-world general intelligence

study.no_tuning: do not change configs, actions, seeds, reward metric, feature normalization, controls, thresholds, or methods once first actual DEV accessed; preserve any engineering corrections and both positive/negative raw artifacts
study.cost_accounting: whole-process CPU/wall/RSS, checkpoint bytes, number of real episodes and all original task outcomes
